Tess (Support): Escalating to CS — SignalWorks pilot complaining about accuracy/regression in answers for medical FAQ. Ticket #33211 has sample prompts and outputs. Customer paused demo. Renewal in ~21 days. Need priority handling.
Rafael (CS): Copy. Do we know tier/committed ARR?
Tess (Support): Startup pilot, < $50k ARR. They flagged hallucinations and bad entity extraction in 3 out of 5 demo queries. Logs attached.
Nora (ML SE): I can repro with their prompt set — appears model selection/temperature mismatch plus a prompt prefix change in our recent deploy. Quick mitigation: pin to previous model variant and set temperature=0.2. Recommend a 48h rollback or variant pin while we investigate.
Rafael (CS): Comms plan: 1) Immediate outreach acknowledging issue + steps taken, 2) Offer pin/rollback and a dedicated 30m troubleshooting session with Nora, 3) Capture feedback for prompt templates and evals, 4) Flag renewal risk in CRM. Owner: Priya to lead outreach.
Priya (CS Manager): I’ll own outreach and send the customer note. @Sam (AE) please include any renewal messaging. Rafael, Nora, please prep the repro and the rollback plan.
Sam (AE): Please include a reassurance line: we’re prioritizing the pilot and will share a remediation timeline. Keep tone confident, not technical.
Tess (Support): Ticket update: "Escalated to CS. Suggested mitigation: pin model to v1.4.2 and temperature 0.2. POC: Priya." Adding sample bad output and curl used for repro in ticket.
Nora (ML SE): I’ll stage the variant pin and test on customer's prompts. If pinned variant fixes >90% of cases, we can offer that as a short-term mitigation.
Priya (CS Manager): Scheduling call: 2024-08-15 10:00 PDT (30m). Invites to SignalWorks, Nora, Rafael, Tess. Action items: (A) Priya send email + outreach, (B) Nora: confirm variant pin & test, (C) Docs: add a note on prompt templates + recommended model variants, (D) CS: set renewal watch & 7-day follow-up.
Liam (Docs): I’ll draft a one-paragraph guidance on recommended prompt scaffolds and include a quick checklist for customers running domain-specific demos by EOD tomorrow.
Rafael (CS): After the call we’ll produce a short playbook entry and a 48h postmortem if this traces to a deploy. Priya will post the customer-facing email here for review.
Tess (Support): Final ticket note for now: "Customer paused demo; mitigation in progress. If pinned variant fails, escalate to model ops oncall."
